## History

Joseph was a cat who originally belonged to a dear friend of [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) before she moved to Vancouver. He moved into Patty's Place when [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) arrived to chaperone [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends during their sophomore year at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). Upon his arrival, Joseph engaged in ongoing skirmishes with Anne's stray cat, [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), though the two animals eventually became friends. Joseph then settled into life at Patty's Place alongside [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) and the other residents throughout their college years.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P1](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0001), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P2](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0002), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P6](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0006), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P10](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0010), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P14](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0014), +159 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--joseph.md)

Joseph resides in the household where [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) lives during her time at Patty's Place, having arrived as one of Aunt Jamesina's cats. Although a relationship record frames Joseph as a pupil in Anne's classroom, he simply functions as one of the household pets sharing space with her. He lives alongside her through her college years as part of the domestic backdrop at Patty's Place.

- Serves under — pupil in her classroom  <sub>[v2 XII A Jonah Day P17](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0017)</sub>

### [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/barbara-shaw--joseph.md)

Joseph is noted as an uncle to [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md). However, their relationship is not depicted in any shared interactions, as Joseph is portrayed as Aunt Jamesina's cat living at Patty's Place while Barbara is only mentioned in Anne's correspondence regarding her students.

- Relative of — uncle  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P33](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0033)</sub>

### [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/joseph--rusty.md)

Joseph and [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) are fellow household cats living together at Patty's Place. When Joseph first arrived, [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) attempted to assert dominance over the newcomer, leading to ongoing skirmishes between the two. They eventually put their initial conflict behind them, becoming close sworn friends who sleep on the same cushion.

- Friend of — became sworn friends after fighting, sleeping on the same cushion (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P65](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0065)</sub>
